methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UNIDIR's publications catalog (~855 items) is server-rendered HTML with dynamic filtering, running on a WordPress-style backend. Cards (title, date, program), facets and numbered pagination are present in the initial HTML, so the catalog is scrapable without a JavaScript engine.

## Search
WordPress-standard full-text search is available via ?s={query} at the site root. Note this searches the whole site, so results should be path-filtered to /publication/. The /publications listing provides faceted browse.

## Filters
The listing exposes rich facets: focus areas (12), programs/projects (7), languages (14) and date range. These render server-side and appear as URL parameters; treated as opaque params (no formal schema).

## Download
Cards link to /publication/{slug}/ record pages. Direct PDF links are NOT exposed in the listing; the download is on the record page. A two-step crawl is required.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Title, publication date and program category are in server-rendered HTML. No JSON/REST API; enrichment is HTML-based (WordPress could theoretically expose /wp-json but this was not verified).

## Limitations
No verified public API. Site-wide ?s= search needs type-filtering. PDFs require resolving each record page. Pagination shows 30/page (~29 pages).
